issuer_rules: Existing or previous Barclays Savings/CD customers are not eligible

requirements: Open a new Barclays Tiered Savings account by October 31, 2026
Fund the new account with at least $25,000 within the first 30 days of opening
Maintain a balance of at least $25,000 for 120 days
Current and previous Barclays customers with a Savings account or CD are not eligible
The bonus is treated as interest for tax purposes and may be reported on Form 1099-INT
